label: Recent apps
help: Apps you closed lately, at the top of Android Apps, each with a picture of its window as you left it.

label: Keep the phone's screen at its top refresh rate
help: While the environment runs. Android draws for the glasses only as often as the phone's own screen refreshes, so glasses above 60 Hz otherwise get 60 frames a second. The phone's setting goes back to how it was when the environment stops.
